cases.name: quosure-mask
cases.description: The wrapper captures caller code with its environment and distinguishes data-mask from environment lookup.
cases.prompt: Write a function that accepts a dplyr-style column expression and an external threshold, then evaluates the expression against a data frame without confusing the column with a same-named caller variable.
traps: Captures only the expression and loses its caller environment

assertions.text: Captures caller input as a quosure when later evaluation needs its environment.
Uses explicit data-mask and caller-environment lookup such as .data and .env.
Avoids string-based code generation and eval(parse()).

cases.name: safe-call-generation
cases.description: The generated AST is structured, allowlisted, and evaluated in a deliberate environment.
cases.prompt: Build a small translator from an allowlisted arithmetic expression to another target language. Describe how to handle unknown calls, escaping, and evaluation.

assertions.text: Builds and inspects structured calls or AST nodes rather than concatenating executable strings.
Rejects or handles unknown AST nodes through an explicit allowlist policy.
Defines target escaping and evaluates only in a deliberately constructed environment.
